answer: An attacker can mint 1,000 keys for free, but each key starts as green timber — unseasoned, worth nothing until it has survived twelve epochs of honest attestation. The signal that matters is age: every epoch a key attests cleanly adds one ring, and only ringed keys earn. A farm must keep 1,000 fakes behaving perfectly for twelve epochs, paying twelve epochs of work per fake, while one honest agent pays twelve epochs once. The karst hides the fakes — identical fresh keys in pockets — but a key that slips even once loses all its rings and restarts at zero.
